WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(fees.feerate) as overall_avg_rate
  FROM fees
  WHERE fees.feerate IS NOT NULL
),
channel_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    orders.orderbase,
    AVG(fees.feerate) as channel_avg_rate
  FROM fees
  JOIN orders ON fees.orderslink = orders.recordvault
  WHERE fees.feerate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY orders.orderbase
),
above_avg_channels AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.channel_avg_rate,
    (cs.channel_avg_rate - oa.overall_avg_rate) as difference_above_avg
  FROM channel_stats cs
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE cs.channel_avg_rate > oa.overall_avg_rate
)
SELECT 
  AVG(channel_avg_rate) as mean_fee_rate_of_above_avg_channels,
  AVG(difference_above_avg) as avg_distance_above_overall_average
FROM above_avg_channels;

assumptions.assumption: Above-average means strictly greater than (>) the overall average, not including equal values

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate the weighted average fee rate across all individual fees in above-average channels (rather than the unweighted mean of each channel's average)
alternatives.sql:
WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(fees.feerate) as overall_avg_rate
  FROM fees
  WHERE fees.feerate IS NOT NULL
),
channel_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    orders.orderbase,
    AVG(fees.feerate) as channel_avg_rate
  FROM fees
  JOIN orders ON fees.orderslink = orders.recordvault
  WHERE fees.feerate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY orders.orderbase
),
above_avg_channel_list AS (
  SELECT cs.orderbase
  FROM channel_stats cs
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE cs.channel_avg_rate > oa.overall_avg_rate
)
SELECT 
  AVG(fees.feerate) as mean_fee_rate_of_above_avg_channels,
  AVG(fees.feerate) - (SELECT overall_avg_rate FROM overall_avg) as avg_distance_above_overall_average
FROM fees
JOIN orders ON fees.orderslink = orders.recordvault
WHERE fees.feerate IS NOT NULL
AND orders.orderbase IN (SELECT orderbase FROM above_avg_channel_list);
